title: Prince Harry at court – level 1
paragraphs: Prince Harry and six other famous people lose a big fight in a London court. They go to court against a big newspaper company.

Harry says that the journalists do bad things to get his secret information and stories. For example, they listen to the phone calls. But the judge says today that Harry and his friends do not have real facts to prove the story. The judge says that feeling bad is not enough for a court.
It is a very long and expensive fight. Now Harry is in London alone for his work. He is not staying with the King because there are many problems between them.

words.d: something what people do not know about
to show that something is true
when something costs a lot of money
